behavior: The contract diagrams show the v1 design with every agreed case: invoice creation checks, dust, cancel, settle window, missed settlement, pause, multisig refunds and recovery; plus a diagram of who holds which key
acceptance: docs/diagrams/contracts-workflow.json, invoice-lifecycle.json and security-keys.json pass the diagrams check

The workflow shows: Privy session and profile check, request validation (idempotency key, token allowlist, minimum), recipient read from the profile wallet, save and watch, checkout warnings, cancel, dust, expiry and late, partial top-up, finalized wait, signer recipient re-check, settle window, missed settlement by the multisig, pause, lazy deploy, settle, held funds, claim and approval, multisig refund, wrong-network or wrong-token review with approve or reject, recover, unsupported network
The lifecycle routes a reorg back through the confirmed total, has a cancelled state, and loops refunds while money is still held
The security diagram shows each key and service, what it can move, and what a leak allows, matching PLAN.md Phase 5 and Phase 6
notes: 2026-10-08 review pass by reviewer: All 3 files pass mapgrain@0.2.5 validate. Every acceptance-2 case is present (auth, valid, recipient, save, checkout, cancel, dust, intime/expiry, partial w23, final, intent, window, missed w30/w31, pause w35, deploy, settle, held, claim/approve, saferefund/refund, support/review/recover, lost). Lifecycle: reorg l2 plus l3/l4 route by confirmed total, cancelled state, refund loop l16. Money/security rules match PLAN: settle executor until window then multisig only, pause stops settle only, refund multisig only, repeatable, never takes amount before window, recover covers other token/native/wrong chain, recipient from Privy re-checked by signer, server has no send rights, leak impact matches. Cosmetic notes: (1) refund/recover say 'deploys the receiver first if needed', but a receiver cannot deploy itself; it is Factory.deploy then the call, e.g. batched in the Safe tx. (2) Lifecycle has no back edge from paid if a safe-block deposit reorgs before finalized (the signer re-check keeps money safe). (3) l8 lets the creator cancel a partially paid invoice; PLAN Phase 9 says 'cancel an unpaid invoice'. (4) Native coin sent after deploy is rejected (payer keeps it), not shown. (5) security-keys deployer node has no explicit 'if leaked' line; signer leak also exposes its gas balance and could settle a funded cancelled invoice to the recipient before the window ends (matches PLAN wording, design note). (6) missed->no (w31) can hardly happen because intime already filters late deposits. (7) security-keys.json is untracked and not linked from PLAN Phase 5 Design.

2026-10-08 review pass by reviewer: Re-review of a691d8f: refund and recover descriptions now say the same Safe transaction calls Factory.deploy first if the receiver is not deployed (fixes note 1); PLAN.md Phase 5 Design links security-keys.json, a 1-line change with no other PLAN edits (fixes note 7); security-keys.json is committed. contracts-workflow.json passes mapgrain@0.2.5 validate (43 nodes). Earlier findings stand: all acceptance lines met, money and security rules match PLAN.md. Remaining cosmetic notes 2-6 from the first review are unchanged and not blocking.
